scope: Each native collector independently; Windows WEF/WEC and nftables via mutual TLS syslog.
measurements: actual source generation rate and native event counters
queue acceptance, retries, dead letters, age and bytes
CPU, resident memory, free disk and queue database/WAL growth
independently queried destination identities and ingestion latency
time from destination restoration to complete backlog delivery
limits: A short burst and an hour of outage traffic do not qualify arbitrary payloads, a proprietary appliance, power loss or a signed production release. Preserve failed phases.
